````text
# #4816: Patch: a card a Transform makes arrives as any card does: one that prints Dormant sleeps, a Phantom Shipyard stays, and a Heroic Power rolls its power
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What happens

A Transform's replacement skips the arrival steps that every other way onto the field runs.

- `crates/engine/src/zones.rs:940-1031` (`replace_in_zone`) starts the replacement's printed Brittle ("the new card has entered the field, so its printed Brittle starts") and nothing else.
- Its caller, `crates/engine/src/effects/transform.rs:51-92` (`replace_on_field`), runs no arrival roll.
- Compare `zones.rs:829-836` (`place_with`): Brittle, then `slumber::start_slumber_on_field`, then `starship::start_starship_on_field`. And `crates/engine/src/effects/summon.rs` (`summon_onto`): `run_start_of_game`.

S+ #103 Transcend ("Transform your permanents into ones that cost (1) more"), #104 Tireless Cultivation and #105 Spacersi draw a random card of the next price. Four results go wrong:

- A (1)-cost Unit becomes S #19 Imprisoned Cosmality (10/6 Pierce, "Dormant for 2 turns. When this awakens, …") with `slumber: None`: a live 10/6 at once, whose "When this awakens" never fires.
- A (2)-cost Field Spell becomes S+ #62 Overdrive Projector ("Dormant for N turns. Your Units gain Rush and Windfury, and your Spells gain Echo") with `slumber: None`: its text is in force at once.
- A (3)-cost Unit becomes S+ #157 Phantom Shipyard (0/0, "Dormant until launched"), awake at 0/0, and the state check kills it in the same action.
- A (0)-cost Field Spell becomes Core #98 Heroic Power with empty `memory` and no prompt: an Indestructible Field Spell with no Activate, for good.

### What should happen

- R1839000: "A Unit that prints it … enters the field Dormant as it arrives from off the field, any way it arrives: played, summoned, put there by a setup. A move from one field zone to another is no arrival". §6.1's Dormant row says the same of a face-up Field Spell (R3556000).
- A Transform's result is a new card that has entered the field: `replace_in_zone` says so itself, and R3039000 says "A copy (R57) or a Transform is a new card without the mark" (the mark that it has already awakened).
- R3134002: "A copy that reaches the field with no Cry rolls one. A copy Summoned, Recruited, fused onto a card on the field, Reborn or Flickered back has no Cry to choose with, so R151's arrival roll stays for it … so a copy is never dead." A Transform fires no Cry (R1).

### How to reproduce

Four tests fail on `main` (3a83bd7), in [`crates/ai/tests/audit_engine_layers.rs` at 1bbcb71](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/1bbcb71ed6319d94421a157960124f0de94e9ac2/crates/ai/tests/audit_engine_layers.rs) (branch `claude/vigilant-mayer-pmyrhr`): `r1839000_a_unit_transformed_into_one_that_prints_dormant_is_dormant`, `r1839000_a_field_spell_transformed_into_one_that_prints_dormant_is_dormant`, `r1839000_a_unit_transformed_into_phantom_shipyard_is_dormant_and_stays`, `r3134002_a_heroic_power_made_by_a_transform_rolls_its_power`. Each searches up to 900 seeds for the one where Transcend lands on the card in question.

```rust
use jackioh_engine::testkit::*;
const P1: PlayerId = PlayerId::P1;
const FILLER: &str = "core-005";
const TRANSCEND: &str = "stinkyscapeplus-103";
const COSMALITY: &str = "stinkyscape-019";

fn transcended_into(name: &str, field: Value, backrow: Value, into: &str) -> (Scenario, String) {
    for n in 0..900 {
        let mut s = scenario(json!({
            "seed": format!("{name}-{n}"),
            "p1": { "hand": [TRANSCEND, FILLER], "field": field.clone(), "backrow": backrow.clone(),
                    "library": [FILLER, FILLER, FILLER], "mana": 10 },
            "p2": { "hand": [FILLER], "library": [FILLER, FILLER, FILLER, FILLER] },
        }));
        s.play(TRANSCEND, json!({}));
        let made = s.events_of("transformed").into_iter().find_map(|event| {
            let event = serde_json::to_value(event).expect("an event is JSON");
            (event["toDefId"] == into).then(|| event["newInstanceId"].as_str().unwrap_or_default().to_string())
        });
        if let Some(id) = made { return (s, id); }
    }
    panic!("no seed of 900 drew {into}");
}
#[test]
fn r1839000_a_unit_transformed_into_one_that_prints_dormant_is_dormant() {
    jackioh_cards::register_all();
    // core-003 costs (1); Transcend makes it a random (2)-cost Unit.
    let (s, id) = transcended_into("dormant-unit", json!(["core-003"]), json!([]), COSMALITY);
    assert!(s.card(id.as_str()).slumber.is_some(),
        "R1839000: Imprisoned Cosmality arrived by a Transform and is not Dormant");
}
```

The other three have the same shape: a (2)-cost Field Spell (`classic-004` in the backrow) into `stinkyscapeplus-062`; a (3)-cost Unit into `stinkyscapeplus-157`, asserting it is still on the field; `stinkyscapeplus-040` in the backrow into `core-098`, asserting `memory.contains_key("power")`.

```

### Where

The rules engine: `crates/engine/src/zones.rs` (`replace_in_zone`), `crates/engine/src/effects/transform.rs` (`replace_on_field`).

### Version or commit

`main` at 3a83bd7.

### Notes for the fix

- In `replace_in_zone`, beside `start_brittle_on_field(state, replacement, true)`, call `slumber::start_slumber_on_field(state, replacement, true)` and `starship::start_starship_on_field(…)`, as `place_with` does. In `replace_on_field`, run `prompts::run_start_of_game` on the placed replacement, as `summon_onto` does.
- A ruling note in this issue's block saying a Transform's result arrives, and which arrival steps it takes. Read R1839000, R1839001, R3039000, R3556000, R3557004, R3134002 and R151 first: none excepts a Transform.
- Deliberately not claimed, because the rulings are less clear ("a Transform is no summon"): `replace_on_field` also skips the Tipsy stamp, `crater::lock_on_arrival` and `animate_on_entry`. Decide each in the ruling note rather than adding them silently. `replace_in_zone` keeping `giga` is ruled (R3546002) and is not part of this.
- A neighbour seen by reading only: `effects/flicker.rs::flicker_card` also runs no `run_start_of_game`, though R3134002 names "Flickered back". Only Classic #14 Shadowstep's Radiant face Flickers and it reaches Units only, so nothing shows today.
- No test pins the current behaviour: `crates/engine/tests/rules/slumber.rs` covers only a Transform passing a Dormant card by.
- For the tests, pin one seed each rather than searching 900, or build the Transform with the testkit directly.
- A card change in play (the three Transform cards and whatever they make): it needs its pending patch fragment (`docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`).
````
